summary: Frontend-only retest of the Sandbox visual rework, at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844, logged in as admin. Every requested flow passed: canvas, ROBOSTRIKE title plate, phase label and turn label ('Tour: 1'); board-select for foundry/cross/arena; robots-select for 2/3/4, with robot tabs that show sprite thumbnails (256px images, none broken), 5 HP segments and 3 lives; cards fill slots in order, slots-count shows n/6, clicking a filled slot empties it and the next card refills that gap, random fills 6 and disables the cards, clear empties; tray-left/right scroll (mobile 0 -> 258 -> 0); resolving with an incomplete program shows the toast 'Tous les robots doivent avoir 6 actions.'; resolve -> phase-label shows 'RÉSOLUTION · S1 · ...', frame-label shows 'Image x/24', prev/play/next all work, the event log lists events (R1 pivote, R2 pivote); new-turn returns to programming with 'Tour: 2' and 0/6 slots. Mobile: horizontal overflow 0, canvas 356px wide inside the 390px viewport, robot plates in 2 columns (4 robots = 2x2), 6 slots of 51x68px each, all usable. No console or page errors on either viewport.

issues: The nav links (Accueil/Sandbox/Multijoueur/Classement/Profil) are hidden on mobile, and the screenshots show no hamburger or other way to reach them; only the logo, language toggle and logout are visible. Please check that mobile users can navigate.
The resolve button and the card console sit below the fold, so the user has to scroll between the cards/slots and the board. Consider a shorter board or putting the console beside it.

A slot holding Shield (def category) looked much dimmer than the other filled slots in the mobile screenshot; the screenshot may have caught a transition. Check the slotNeon colour contrast for the 'def' category.

action_items: Optional: give mobile a way to reach the nav links (hamburger or similar)
Optional: wrap the api.post in resolve() and startSandbox() in try/catch with an error toast (today a network error gives an unhandled promise rejection and no feedback)
Optional: in newTurn, `findIndex(...) || 0` yields -1 when every robot is eliminated (-1 is truthy). Use an explicit check, e.g. `Math.max(0, idx)`
critical_code_review_comments: Sandbox.jsx resolve()/startSandbox(): no error handling or loading state around the API calls; double-clicking resolve can fire 2 requests.
Sandbox.jsx newTurn: activeIdx can become -1 when all robots are eliminated (findIndex -1 || 0 evaluates to -1), so activeRobot is undefined. It is guarded later, but the code is fragile.
GameCanvas.jsx is 549 lines, close to the 700-line split threshold.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sandbox testids: board-select, robots-select, sandbox-reset, game-canvas, board-title, phase-label, turn-label, robot-tab-N, robot-lives-N, card-<actionId>, card-tray, tray-left/right, slot-0..5, slots-count, program-random, program-clear, resolve-btn, step-prev/play/next, frame-label, new-turn-btn, event-log. The UI defaults to French. Login testids: login-email, login-password, auth-submit.
